blocks.x: But it was hearing you with Lloyd Price, who was in that band with the Lloyd Price band?

Well a guy named Arthur Horrell, he was a very popular trumpet player in around Gary, Indiana, in Chicago. A guy named, oh I've forgotten what his name is, but we called him Shaky. He was a trumpet player, we had three trumpets in the ring. We was a trumpet. And the saxophone section of the guy had a guy named Charles Reeves, and Ray Holloway, playing tenor, and Bean Bowl, I forgot Bean's first name, everybody called him Bean Bowl. He was playing baritone. And Chuck McClendon played tenor, saxophone. We had four saxophones, three trumpets. Sam Hurd played trombone, and Wade Marcus played trombone. David, I don't think what David's name was. I was trying to think of the piano player's name. I know the first name was David. And Wilbur Hogan played drums. Bill Jones played guitar. Okay.
And the last two I know were from New Orleans. Who else was from New Orleans in that band? Lester never played with the band. Excuse me? Lester didn't play with that band.
